description: This file manages test project editing functionalities including creating, editing, updating, deleting, and setting project statuses. It handles HTTP request processing, interacts with various project management classes, and renders responses using Smarty templates.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test project operations such as create, update, delete, and retrieval.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: Class interfacing with issue trackers linked to test projects.

classes.name: tlCodeTracker
classes.description: Class interfacing with code trackers linked to test projects.

classes.name: tlReqMgrSystem
classes.description: Class managing requirements management systems linked to test projects.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP standard class used to create simple objects.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes request arguments and session data into a structured object, sanitizing input and retrieving linked tracker IDs.

methods.name: prepareOptions
methods.description: Prepares project options based on input arguments into a singleton object.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new test project, including validation, linkage to trackers, and copying requirements if specified.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing test project, including updating linked trackers, roles, and logging the event.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares and returns data for editing an existing test project.

methods.name: crossChecks
methods.description: Performs validation on project data such as name uniqueness and prefix duplication during create/update.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares the default form data for creating a new test project.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a project and logs the deletion event.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI-related data, such as available trackers, for project management interface.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to manage projects.
